# sqlpipe v2.0

## Breaking changes

**`/v2/users` name split.** `name` field removed. Replaced by `first_name` and `last_name`. Update clients before upgrading. Old payloads rejected with 400.

Migration:
```json
// before
{ "name": "Ada Lovelace" }
// after
{ "first_name": "Ada", "last_name": "Lovelace" }
```

## New features

**`--incremental` flag.** Pipes only rows changed since last run. Tracks watermark per source. Skips full-table rescans on large tables.

```bash
sqlpipe run --incremental config.yaml
```

## Performance

**Parquet writes 40% faster.** Column encoder rewritten. No config change needed. Measured on 10M-row benchmark, mixed schema.

## Upgrade

```bash
go install github.com/sqlpipe/sqlpipe@v2.0.0
```
